card.name: Small linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, as, in or such, placed right before a specific drug or brand name is about to appear. Most often after phrases like "a component of" or "treatment with".

modes.label: Component of a product
modes.description: The word "of" after "a component" in a combination-drug context, just before the product brand name.
